messages:
marta: Kickoff for Lodestar POC — they want Kite-65B deployed in their VPC (private). Must pass HIPAA, integrate with their KMS, and meet 99.9% latency SLOs for short responses. They also want a catalog-fit note and a ballpark committed cost comparison vs our usual 13/34B plans. Any obvious blockers?
ryan: Tokenizer + compat are first checks. Does Kite-65B use the same byte-BPE we have? Need vocab file + tokenizer config. Also confirm rotary vs ALiBi/rope, that changes kernel selection. KV-cache footprint per session could be significant.
marta: Sales asked for a short checklist to hand to the customer and a rough Dedicated monthly vs hosted delta.
tara: For 65B on private: recommend 4x A100-80GB with KV sharding for steady throughput, or 2x H100 (nvlink) if they need low tail latency. Either requires reserved capacity for private. Also confirm whether they accept cross-node KV-shard traffic—some customers disallow it.
ales: Proposed POC model config (devs please sanity-check):

```
model: kite-65b-v1
variant: lodestar-poc-1
quant: q4_K_M
tokenizer: byte-bpe (verify)
kv_shards: 4
hw_hint: A100-80GB
seq_len: 4096
expected_rps: 3-8
```

ales: If tokenizer/vocab mismatch, we can insert a mapping/transcoding layer but expect 5-15% perf hit.
ryan: FYI q4 quantization often saves memory/cost but can drop long-context accuracy; I'll run a quick eval if we get the prompt set. Need the artifact stored in staging S3.
sam: Legal/security checklist: we need completed vendor security questionnaire, model provenance (weight origin, license), SHA256 checksums for artifacts, and confirmation there is no outbound telemetry. For HIPAA also require KMS audit logs and DPA signed.
nina: I'll coordinate on security docs. Also will need to review the customer network diagram for private deploy.
marta: Can someone rough out perf delta A100 vs H100 and q4 vs q8 for this model so we can give sales a swallowable estimate?
tara: I can run microbenchmarks on staging once artifact + a 20-entry prompt set are uploaded. ETA 48 hours. I'll try both q8_0 and q4_K_M on A100 and H100.
ryan: I'll queue a tokenizer check and variant-scan. Please tag me when artifact is uploaded: s3 path or presigned link.
deploy-bot: queued deploy job DJ-1291: infra-staging kite-65b-v1 (awaiting artifact) scheduled 2026-04-01T14:00:00Z.
marta: Action list: (1) Sales upload artifact + eval prompts (sales/marta) (2) Ryan: tokenizer + variant scan (ryan) (3) Tara: perf baselines A100/H100 + q4/q8 (tara) (4) Nina: collect security + DPA (nina) (5) Ales/finance: ballpark committed vs hosted delta for 65B. Quick sync tomorrow 11:30 PT? :calendar: :thumbsup:
ales: I'll pull numbers from finance and post a back-of-envelope today.
marta: Thanks all — will set calendar invite and push checklist doc to sales to hand to Lodestar.
